title: Harriet Tubman Charter turns energy efficiency into opportunities for students
summary: Entergy New Orleans supports organizations that are finding creative ways to manage energy, strengthen sustainability and make every dollar count. Crescent City Schools’ Harriet Tubman Charter is putting those principles into action through its participation in Entergy New Orleans’ Energy Smart programs. Source

title: Keep your family safe as fall brings new routines, shorter days and cooler temperatures
summary: As cooler air begins to arrive, families turn the page from summer fun to a host of activities that take advantage of the fall season, from pumpkin spice everything and hayrides to fall festivals and football. Entergy Louisiana offers these tips for keeping your family safe through it all. Source

title: Ampirical and Entergy: A partnership powering Louisiana’s workforce, communities and future
summary: Ampirical Solutions, LLC — a long standing engineering and grid services partner to Entergy Louisiana — is expanding its headquarters and plans to add 175 new high wage technical jobs. This growth will deepen Louisiana’s energy workforce, accelerate critical grid and data center projects and fuel statewide economic momentum. Source

title: Seeing more, repairing smarter: How advanced NDE and repair technologies are changing nuclear asset management
summary: A single ultrasonic inspection of reactor vessel upper head penetrations can generate more than 7 kilometers of inspection data. Historically, analysts have spent days—even weeks—reviewing those results to identify the few indications that might require further evaluation. In 2025, Vattenfall Nuclear in Sweden demonstrated a different approach. By qualifying and deploying an artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML)–assisted ultrasonic inspection process in collaboration with the Swedish Qualification Centre at Ringhals-3, the utility reduced data review workload by up to 95 percent while maintaining rigorous inspection requirements. A subsequent deployment at Ringhals-4 saved approximately one week on inspection activities.
